adaptations.description: The machines sink a redundant brace lattice into the Heartforge shell where repeated frontal impacts are breaking through.
adaptations.problem: Observed damage is concentrating on the Heartforge perimeter.
adaptations.tradeoff: The anchored shell absorbs the most direct damage, but its heavy service frame makes ordinary machine activity louder.

adaptations.description: The machines hollow the outer ring into a replaceable buffer so the living core sits behind a deliberately expendable shell.
adaptations.problem: The Heartforge needs a buffer that can fail without exposing the core immediately.
adaptations.tradeoff: The hollow reduces incoming damage, but its exposed service cavities draw more organic attention during construction and repair.

adaptations.description: The machines wrap the cognition core in damped shrouds that lower the ordinary signal reaching the surrounding ecology.
adaptations.problem: Organic pressure is concentrating around the Heartforge's ordinary machine signature.
adaptations.tradeoff: The quiet core attracts less routine attention, but it leaves less physical shell between a determined assault and the core.
